rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday Cantonese word for underpants.

example.english: Your underpants are torn, so change them quickly.
example.traditional: 你條底褲爛咗，快啲換啦。
example.jyutping: nei5 tiu4 dai2 fu3 laan6 zo2 faai3 di1 wun6 laa1

rows.note: A neutral alternative used when referring generally to underwear worn under outer clothes.

example.english: Before leaving the house, remember to bring an extra pair of underpants.
example.traditional: 出門口之前，記得帶多條內褲。
example.jyutping: ceot1 mun4 hau2 zi1 cin4 gei3 dak1 daai3 do1 tiu4 noi6 fu3
